entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help. I need to return my VeloBand GPS tracker. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-015B. I just feel awful about this. I've been a loyal customer for years and I really needed this money back.

I understand. Thank you for that order number. I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th. Before we go further, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's just a preference thing. It wasn't for me. But I tried to return it way earlier, back in December. I went to the website and there was a huge website error. The whole return system was down.
I see. So you attempted to process the return online previously?

Yes, on the ninth day! I remember because I had a calendar reminder. The page just kept crashing and I couldn't print the label. I even took a screenshot of the error message because I was so frustrated. I just gave up after a while and the holidays got so busy.

I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just check our system logs for that period... one moment... Ah. Yes, I do see a record of a known service outage that affected our returns portal around that time. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience that caused you.
Oh, really? So it wasn't just me? I was so worried you wouldn't believe me.

No, it was definitely our fault. Given the circumstances, let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. Okay, I'm checking our official return policy now... and it looks like you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. Thank you so, so much, Isaac.

It's my pleasure to help. I've just processed the return for you and a new shipping label has been sent to your email on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the item, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You've been wonderful. I really appreciate your help today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
